races.name: Anglo Printers Remembering John H. Kierans Mares Hurdle

runners_data.name: Swing Davis
runners_data.spotlight: Point-to-point winner; landed Navan maiden hurdle by 8.5l in March 2025; failed to complete three starts since, in a Grade 1 mares' novice at Fairyhouse (pulled up) and in beginners' chases at Down Royal (pulled up) and back at Fairyhouse (unseated); questions to answer on return to hurdling.

runners_data.name: Run For Mahler
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper and maiden hurdle winner; soundly beaten in Grade 2 novice at Cheltenham when last sighted in October; ran well in a maiden hurdle over C&D last September; lacks a recent run and probably best watched unless market speaks.

runners_data.name: Murcia
runners_data.spotlight: Top-rated here at 138; won Grade 1 at Aintree in April 2025, her last start on ground with good in the description; below best in hot handicaps this year but better expected now back on a sounder surface; giving weight away to most of her rivals but the one to beat.

runners_data.name: Chosen Comrade
runners_data.comment: Has 12l to find with Echoing Silence on their Punchestown meeting in December
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper, point-to-point and maiden hurdle winner; limitations seemingly exposed in Listed mares' novice at Punchestown and in the Mares' Novice at Cheltenham; rated 120 and improvement required.

runners_data.name: Grainne A Chroi
runners_data.comment: Good standard in mares' races, probably best over further and on easier ground
runners_data.spotlight: Talented mare has finished out of the first three just twice in six starts over hurdles; won a Grade 3 at Punchestown in February (2m4f, soft); pulled up in Fairyhouse Grade 2 latest; best form on soft ground so rain would boost claims.

runners_data.name: Royal Hollow
runners_data.spotlight: 3-14 over hurdles and rated 128; won a Clonmel beginners' chase on her penultimate start (15.5f, yld-sft); modest third in mares' listed hurdle at Killarney latest (2m1f, gd-yld); solid place chance on the figures but more needed to win.

runners_data.name: On A Diamond
runners_data.comment: Tailed off in 2m4f bumper last month
runners_data.spotlight: Tailed off in Clonmel bumper on debut and in a 4yo Cork maiden hurdle on latest; impossible to make a case for.

runners_data.name: Katherine
runners_data.comment: No show on both recent outings but can't be ruled out down in grade here
runners_data.spotlight: 3-28 over hurdles but rated just 98 and has been out of form for some time; would be a surprise winner in this company.

races.name: Join The Listowel Races Supporters Club Maiden Hurdle

runners_data.name: Beechingstoke
runners_data.comment: Pulled up when 28-1 in Fairyhouse bumper in December, can only be watched after that
runners_data.spotlight: 28-1 and pulled up in a Fairyhouse bumper in December; can only be watched after that.

runners_data.name: Straightenyourhand
runners_data.spotlight: Sent off 100-1 at Killarney on debut and ran like it.

runners_data.name: Penny Express
runners_data.comment: Placed in four of his five outings in maidens, not as effective in his two handicap runs
runners_data.spotlight: Placed three times in maiden hurdles, including over C&D at this meeting last season; jumped left throughout when pulled up at Clonmel on seasonal return; place chance if his consistency returns.

runners_data.name: Gomez Addams
runners_data.spotlight: Impressed with an easy bumper win for Andy Slattery at the Galway festival last season, with a subsequent Listed winner back in third; ran disappointingly on stable debut at Leopardstown over Christmas (2m, good to yielding); he's better than that; interesting contender making his hurdles debut.

runners_data.name: Bells Grove
runners_data.comment: Third at Cheltenham on final start for John McConnell; market can reveal expectations
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in all three 2025 bumper runs for John McConnell; could only manage eighth at Kilbeggan on stable debut; needs to return to his best now, making his hurdles bow.

runners_data.name: Touch The Moon
runners_data.comment: Back from hurdling; yard going well, not one to rule out
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time winner on the Flat on good/good to firm ground, rated 90; some top runs in defeat over hurdles; beaten a short head at Navan in September and third behind the classy Talk The Talk at Limerick next time; soft ground likely against him at Cheltenham in November; positive return to action on the level at Leopardstown last time when second; big player.

runners_data.name: Small Fry
runners_data.comment: Useful on Flat; modest both hurdle runs in UK but could do better now is more mature
runners_data.spotlight: Five Flat wins in UK and ran respectably in two autumn Flat starts for this yard after 100,000gns purchase; previous efforts over hurdles were modest but there was promise in his run at Down Royal (2m2f, good) earlier this month when staying on for fourth; entitled to improve over that return; contender.

runners_data.name: Dar Toungi
runners_data.spotlight: Eight Flat wins when trained in France, including at Listed level; nowhere near that form in three runs on the level for this yard; likely best watched on hurdles debut unless money comes.

runners_data.name: Ballinvasas Best
runners_data.spotlight: Some promise in his 2024 maiden runs but can only be watched returning from a 645-day absence.

runners_data.name: Mc Swagger
runners_data.comment: Bumper promise but faces a stiff examination on hurdle debut
runners_data.spotlight: Close third in the second of his three bumpers, so has ability; faced a tough task in a Killarney novice contest when unseating at the last (2m4f, good to yielding, 125-1); others preferred.

runners_data.name: Calzaghi
runners_data.comment: Flat winner was placed in final three starts for Kevin Coleman; makes hurdles/stable bow
runners_data.spotlight: Won a Flat handicap in 2024; tailed off on stable/hurdles debut at Killarney; likeley to be of more interest in handicaps.

runners_data.name: Approval
runners_data.comment: Progressive 3yo on Flat in 2024, winning twice; hasn't reached those heights since
runners_data.spotlight: Progressive 3yo for William Haggas in 2024, winning twice over 1m2f on good to firm; hasn't reached those heights since and was tailed off at Killarney on hurdles/stable debut; hood worn that day now left off.

runners_data.name: Forlio
runners_data.comment: Won off 9lb lower at Navan in October, stamina to prove for this trip, on tough mark
runners_data.spotlight: Dual Flat winner is rated 62 in that sphere; some okay runs on the level recently; much more needed to make immediate impact now over hurdles.

runners_data.name: Pinkarizon
runners_data.spotlight: 17,000euros yearling was purchased for 40,000gns as a 2yo; half-brother to winners Rajinsky (7f-2m2f inc 2yo/AW/Listed; RPR 116), Bakhit (1m2f inc AW; 70) and Karamazov (Slovakian 1m 2yo); dam maiden from 5.7f-1m1f (60), half-sister to 1m Listed winner Boomshackerlacker; hooded and tongue tied for debut.

runners_data.name: Desertmore Charm
runners_data.comment: Nothing in 2 runs so far inc' when tailed off here last week
runners_data.spotlight: No sign of winning potential in a bumper and two maiden hurdles; unlikely.

runners_data.name: Phoenix Arizona
runners_data.spotlight: 0-7 in points; placed in two small-field maiden hurdles last year; beaten 23l at Kilbeggan when last seen over hurdles; tailed off over fences back there last time; hood goes on but hard to fancy.

runners_data.name: Suresuresure
runners_data.spotlight: Has shown nothing of note in five bumpers; hard to make a case for on hurdles debut.

runners_data.name: Pegasuslane
runners_data.spotlight: 200-1 and tailed off on debut in a Limerick bumper; hard to fancy on that evidence.

runners_data.name: Jack Owen Jack
runners_data.comment: Second on debut at Cork 215 days ago; pulled clear with useful winner; likely player
runners_data.spotlight: Solid efforts when runner-up in bumper at Cork (2m3f, good) and when close third at Kilbeggan after a break on latest (18.5f, good); trip and ground fine and while his dam is flat-bred, he's by a top-class national hunt sire; interesting on hurdling debut.

runners_data.name: Black Dakota
runners_data.comment: Useful form in points, twice runner-up since Cragmore win in January, cheekpieces on now
runners_data.spotlight: Point-to-point winner; modest effort on Rules' debut in a novice hunter chase at Wexford (RPR 99); probably up against it on hurdles debut.

runners_data.name: Withabitofluk
runners_data.comment: Bumper winner showed promise in maidens but tailed off on h'cap debut last time; headgear
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper winner on good to yielding; 0-5 over hurdles and rated 113; leading claims on the form of his maiden hurdle runs at Naas and Navan last year but bitterly disappointing in both starts in handicaps in 2026; huge chance if he can rediscover best but comes with risks attached.

runners_data.name: Carajillo
runners_data.spotlight: 50-1 but offered something to build on when making modest late gains into midfield at Kilbeggan; this longer trip a plus but was beaten 30l last time so much more needed.

runners_data.name: Speed For Fun
runners_data.spotlight: 1-9 on the Flat in France, the win coming over 1m2f (soft); not the easiest to assess from a form perspective but leading yard usually does well with French recruits and no surprise to see him make an immediate impact; the market should prove informative.

runners_data.name: Burning Ability
runners_data.comment: Form figures of 232 in bumpers, closely matched with two of these, chance
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in two of three starts in bumpers; good second in a Limerick maiden hurdle in December (2m3f, sft-hvy); off since tailed off in Limerick bumper in February; a repeat of his last run over hurdles would give him a squeak here.

runners_data.name: Royal Approval
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time AW winner on the Flat; okay efforts in maiden hurdles at Navan and Limerick last autumn without really threatening to win; will qualify for a handicap mark after this.

runners_data.name: Ajp Falco
runners_data.spotlight: No impact in bumpers at Fairyhouse and Punchestown; beaten when falling on hurdles debut at Clonmel (33-1); others preferred.

runners_data.name: Jay Pee M
runners_data.spotlight: Attracted heavy market support at Cork last time (2m3f, good) but could only manage fifth; punters likely attracted by now 19lb lower hurdles mark, but dual chase winner is yet to match that form in this sphere; may want softer ground than this.

runners_data.name: King Ferdinand
runners_data.spotlight: Five-time winner is best watched on return from such a long absence unless market speaks positively.

runners_data.name: Mollys Dolly
runners_data.comment: Pulled up in last two starts and a lot to find based on her mark
runners_data.spotlight: Bounced back from two poor runs when an 8.75l fifth in a moderate Wexford maiden hurdle (2m4f, good to yielding) last time; more needed.

runners_data.name: Poppycon
runners_data.comment: Faller at Tramore but previous C&D second gives him claims; reserve
runners_data.spotlight: Standout run over hurdles when good second in a novice handicap at Wexford in March (2m, soft) on handicap debut; beaten when faller two out over 2m4f at Tramore last month but not ruled out if handling this better ground; tongue tie goes on.

runners_data.name: Sean Mc
runners_data.comment: 2m4f winner here last month but 3m run since inconclusive; reserve
runners_data.spotlight: Breakthrough win came at Wexford in April over this trip (good to yielding) off 6lb lower; never counted over 3m1f at Kilbeggan a fortnight later; drop back to this trip should suit; player.

runners_data.name: Dunany Point
runners_data.comment: Soft no use to him both starts this year, better ground now, has C&D form, interesting
runners_data.spotlight: Won off 6lb lower at Bellewstown last April (20.5f, good); struggled on softer ground in opening two starts this year and good ground at Sligo brought just modest improvement when sent off 11-2 j-fav'; something to prove now.

runners_data.name: Bravemans Bounce
runners_data.comment: Triple-figure odds for both maidens and ran like it
runners_data.spotlight: Third reserve; three maiden runs don't give much encouragement, but could improve now handicapping.

runners_data.name: Jaadil
runners_data.comment: Progressive in the autumn; C&D winner and second last time; interesting if fit
runners_data.spotlight: Progressive in the autumn; runner-up at Navan (2m3f, yielding) before gaining a first win in emphatic fashion at Cork (2m3f, good); good effort at Sligo next time when runner-up; reported to have mucus when pulled up on seasonal return at Cork last time; chance at her best.

runners_data.name: Ask The Bookie
runners_data.spotlight: 0-19 under rules; fairly modest form last season; others preferred.

runners_data.name: Where Are You Now
runners_data.comment: Fav' for h'cap debut when denied by a head; new trip may suit; big player
runners_data.spotlight: Second reserve; well-backed for handicap debut at Punchestown (2m, soft to heavy) when a costly mistake at two out saw him beaten by a head after rallying; couldn't justify favouritism upped in trip back at Punchestown (3m, good to yielding) last time.

runners_data.name: Illtakehimmyself
runners_data.comment: Stayed on for a distant fifth on h'cap; step up in trip may help
runners_data.spotlight: Best run came on second handicap start at Punchestown (good to yielding) last time when upped to 3m for the first time and beaten a short head off 3lb lower; the abandonment of the first-time tongue tie worn that day and the drop back in trip are both question marks now but good chance with a repeat of latest run.

runners_data.name: Le Fanu
runners_data.comment: Best form at this venue, 3rd here in November (2m, heavy); beaten 29l in 5th here in Feb'
runners_data.spotlight: 0-17 but has run okay at times; 6l fourth of 14 at Limerick (2m4f, soft to heavy) last time was positive but best form is on softer ground.

runners_data.name: Johnny M
runners_data.spotlight: First reserve; winless from ten starts and returned from a long absence when tailed off at Punchestown on stable debut; new headgear tried now.

runners_data.name: Sekakarma
runners_data.comment: Weak form in maiden hurdles, 50-1 when pulled up on handicap debut last December
runners_data.spotlight: Showed notable improvement in his second handicap start at Punchestown (2m, good to yielding) when weakening into fifth of 18; needs to build on that.

runners_data.name: Sonny Fella
runners_data.spotlight: Yet to trouble the judge in 14 starts; beaten 18l in a maiden hurdle (2m, good to yielding) at Kilbeggan last time and handicap runs are not encouraging either.

runners_data.name: Doyen Og
runners_data.comment: Reserve; good third in Aug' but didn't build on that in subsequent runs
runners_data.spotlight: Good third at Bellewstown (2m1f, good) in August off 2lb higher but didn't build on that in subsequent runs; makes seasonal return now.

runners_data.name: Tellmemamema
runners_data.comment: Related to winners and first maiden run was respectable; one to note on handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Outran 80-1 odds at Down Royal (2m2f, good) on handicap debut earlier this month when fourth of 20, staying on well; this trip could bring further improvement.

runners_data.name: Move It On Over
runners_data.comment: Was 100-1 but only beaten 15l on handicap debut at Ballinrobe when last seen in August
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten 15l at Ballinrobe last August on handicap debut (2m1f, good, 100-1); well beaten at Down Royal on seasonal return (2m2f, good); entitled to come on from that but others preferred.

runners_data.name: Loughrask Jet
runners_data.comment: Tailed off on handicap debut; better ground needs to bring improvement
runners_data.spotlight: Tailed off on handicap debut at Thurles (2m4f, heavy) and better ground didn't bring much improvement at Kilbeggan last time (2m3f, good to yielding).

runners_data.name: Mr Eastwood
runners_data.spotlight: Has shown some ability in maiden hurdles but poor efforts in two chases and on handicap hurdle debut at Limerick (2m5f, heavy); cheekpieces go on but others more likely.

runners_data.name: Strand Street Lass
runners_data.comment: Handicap debutante, shown nothing in maidens, blinkers on, hard to fancy; reserve
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to complete either point-to-point and tailed off in completed runs under rules; impossible to fancy; blinkers added to tongue tie now; declared for 7.00 at Tramore on Friday.

runners_data.name: Elusive Ogie
runners_data.comment: Maiden winner; it was a strong handicap in which he was midfield last time at Cork
runners_data.spotlight: Limerick maiden hurdle winner this time last year (2m1f, good); travelling smoothly and looked likely to be involved in the finish when sprawling and unseating at the second last at Limerick last time off this mark (2m4f, good to yielding); lightly raced and dangerous if repeating; good third in the Lartigue (2m, good to yielding) in other run at this track.

runners_data.name: Rockonliam
runners_data.comment: Maiden winner, improved effort at Wexford latest, Darragh O'Keefe prefers Lambay Island
runners_data.spotlight: Killarney maiden hurdle winner (2m4f, yielding) last season, beating Big Dispute by 0.75l; cruised easily to the lead before emptying late on at Leopardstown (2m5f, good to yielding) when last seen over Christmas; that performance suggests a win off this mark is within reach but may improve for this return.

runners_data.name: Garnacho
runners_data.comment: Struggled since big hike for Bellewstown win; down in grade but still opposable
runners_data.spotlight: Justified strong market support when scoring by 12l on debut for this yard at Bellewstown (2m5f, good) in July; has struggled off 16lb higher mark in three runs since; may need some help from the handicapper.

runners_data.name: Tir Og
runners_data.comment: Highly progressive in the early part of last season, probably too high in the ratings now
runners_data.spotlight: Progressed really well in the early part of last season, rising 30lb in the ratings, stemming from three wins and two seconds; probably too high in the ratings now; unsuited by race conditions at Killarney when tailed off last time; others more likely.

runners_data.name: Therellbguddaysyet
runners_data.comment: Ran well in the face of an unrealistic task on stable debut
runners_data.spotlight: Good ground Thurles maiden hurdle winner who has been placed off this mark; ran a decent race faced with an unrealistic task at Cork on stable debut and another positive effort at Killarney when fifth back in handicap company (4.25l behind Falco Blitz); blinkers go on and he's lightly-raced for his age.

runners_data.name: High Court Cave
runners_data.comment: Absent since winning at Downpatrick in Sept'; player if ready to rock
runners_data.spotlight: Point and bumper winner added a hurdles win at Downpatrick in September (2m2f, yielding); creditable return to action at Punchestown earlier this month when seventh of 24 (2m, yielding), shaping as though he would improve; not ruled out.

runners_data.name: Falco Blitz
runners_data.comment: Potentially well handicapped but he is a 12yo returning from a long absence
runners_data.spotlight: Six-time winner (four chases, two hurdles) holds a 14lb lower hurdles mark and ran a very encouraging race returning from an absence at Killarney when third; entitled to improve on that; interesting.

runners_data.name: Hamsiyann
runners_data.comment: 2nd in this race off 1lb lower in 2024; stablemates in Chester Cup may be a good pointer
runners_data.spotlight: Dual Flat winner's sole success over hurdles came at the Cheltenham November meeting in 2024 when successful off 7lb lower (2m5f, good); beaten 31l in a quality Aintree handicap in April (2m1f, good to soft) when last seen over obstacles; run on the Flat at Chester wasn't too encouraging either.

runners_data.name: Earl Neigh
runners_data.comment: Ability in maidens over shorter, step up in trip could suit in first h'cap, check market
runners_data.spotlight: Some promise in his maiden over 2m-2m4f on varying ground; always behind when upped to 3m2f for his handicap debut at Sligo; needs to bounce back.

runners_data.name: Bop Wont Stop
runners_data.comment: Ran well here on rules' bow but nowhere near that level after; best watched after absence
runners_data.spotlight: Creditable return from over a year off at Cork (2m3f, good) when a 9l fourth of 15, hampered and made a mistake late on; in the mix if backing it up.

runners_data.name: Big Dispute
runners_data.comment: Led each time when placed in three maiden hurdles last year; good Flat run here lately
runners_data.spotlight: Struggled after winning a bumper on debut; staged a revival last summer when placed in three maiden hurdles; well backed and ran creditably in a Cork rated novice hurdle last time when third (2m2f, good); getting the hang of things and should be thereabouts.

runners_data.name: One And Only
runners_data.spotlight: Added a second hurdles win at Limerick (2m7f, heavy) in March off 6lb lower;  couldn't back it up at Cork (3m, yielding) last time when a 16.5l eighth; others preferred.

runners_data.name: Chanceawetmorning
runners_data.comment: Won easily at Kilbeggan on stable debut, raised by 9lb, rider's 5lb claim is an asset
runners_data.spotlight: Unbeaten from two starts since joining this yard; well-backed to win a Kilbeggan handicap in April (2m1f, good to yielding) and followed up with today's rider aboard at Clonmel next time; made to work harder to win last time and is up another 7lb, but this step up in trip could unlock a bit more.

races.name: In Memory Of Josephine Lyons 110 Series Final Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Ceroc
runners_data.comment: Yet to win over fences but plenty of good runs incl' here; poor over hurdles last time
runners_data.spotlight: Dual hurdles winner was poor at Wexford in April off 4lb higher (2m4f, good to yielding) but rebounded over fences back there last time when a distant second of 11 (3m2f, good to yielding); can't be ruled out but others are more appealing.

runners_data.name: Brideswell Lad
runners_data.comment: Hasn't convinced since January return over both hurdles and fences
runners_data.spotlight: Eight-time winner (two over hurdles) but not since May 2024; missed the entirety of 2025; hasn't convinced in runs this year, both over fences and hurdles; holds 27lb lower rating compared to chasing but others preferred.

runners_data.name: Only For Our Man
runners_data.comment: 7lb rise for Down Royal win on latest fair, rider's claim an asset, go well again
runners_data.spotlight: Point-to-point winner got off the mark in a 2m6f novice handicap (good) at Down Royal last month with an easy 7l victory; good run off 7lb higher under today's rider when beaten a head at Cork (3m1f, good); up another 4lb and enters higher grade, but big player with cheekpieces added.

runners_data.name: Somersby Roost
runners_data.comment: Point winner was tailed off in a C&D maiden last time
runners_data.spotlight: Point-to-point winner made the breakthrough under Rules at Cork (2m3f, good) in her second handicap with an easy 7l win; given a sizeable 10lb hit for that but has scope to improve up in trip with the ground to suit.

runners_data.name: Its Not Over Yet
runners_data.comment: Poor on chase debut last time making her return; can do better back in this sphere
runners_data.spotlight: Won two 3m hurdles in 2024; some fine runs in defeat last year, but was poor on chase debut making her return at Limerick; some improvement back over hurdles at Bellewstown last time, but improvement required.

runners_data.name: Way Down South
runners_data.spotlight: Point/maiden hurdle/beginners' chase winner; more fluent jumping in the final stages at Limerick (2m6f, soft) would have seen him go closer than the 2.25l losing margin; tapped for toe at Cork (2m3f, good) last time back in trip when third; return to this distance is a positive; in the mix.

runners_data.name: Whatsavailable
runners_data.comment: Was third off this mark at Cork last time; a player with a repeat
runners_data.spotlight: His three hurdle wins came at Fairyhouse on good ground at 2m4f-3m but nothing since late 2024; some cracking runs in defeat though, including when third off this mark at Cork (3m, yielding); challenging for the lead when unseated at the third last at Wexford last time; down to an attractive mark.

runners_data.name: Rhythmic Tune
runners_data.comment: Won a 2m5f Limerick h'cap last autumn but not as good twice since; cheekpieces added
runners_data.spotlight: Won a 2m5f Limerick handicap on yielding ground last October but moderate in three runs since; needs to return to his best; remains 4lb above winning mark.

runners_data.name: Shesakindofmagic
runners_data.comment: Bumper winner; yet to be seen if this opening mark is fair on balance of form
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper winner in 2024 (yielding to soft); beaten 22l in seventh on handicap debut at Cork (2m3f, good) last time, jumping lacking fluency; more needed.

runners_data.name: Silent Guardian
runners_data.comment: Hurdles winner in March and was just behind Pavilion End in 1m4f AW handicap in October
runners_data.spotlight: Scored on second handicap hurdle start over 2m3f at Clonmel in March (soft) off 99 when dropped in grade; moderate on the Flat at Roscommon 12 days ago; this is a tougher task than his win but can't be dismissed.

runners_data.name: Embrace The Day
runners_data.comment: Best effort yet at Kilbeggan in first-time tongue-tie (retained) when fourth; in the mix
runners_data.spotlight: Promise when winning a point for Jonathan Fogarty; didn't show much in first five hurdle starts but best effort yet at Kilbeggan (19.5f, good to yielding) in first-time tongue-tie (retained) when fourth of 15; got tired late on when upped to 2m6f (soft) at Limerick on Saturday; stamina query now.

races.name: Oliver Broderick (Pro/Am) Fillies INH Flat Race

runners_data.name: Don'Trushraven
runners_data.spotlight: Workforce filly; third foal; dam point and 2m-2m6f hurdle winner, out of point winning half-sister to bumper winner Chunky and 1m2f Flat/2m hurdle winner Quill Project; yard had a recent bumper winner at Kilbeggan; check the market.

runners_data.name: Lake Pippaway
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to complete both starts in points on easy ground; Getaway filly's dam was a useful bumper winner and liked good ground so could improve; worth monitoring in the market.

runners_data.name: Lavender Berry
runners_data.spotlight: Maxios filly; half-sister to winners Pilot Show (3m/3m1f chase) and Cuchcullan's Son (point); dam unraced half-sister to winners Sa Fureur (smart 2m-2m4f hurdle/chase) and King's Odyssey (useful 2m4f-3m hurdle/chase); may need further than this in time; watch.

runners_data.name: Lily Lovelace
runners_data.spotlight: Ulysses filly; 5,000gns foal; half-sister to winners Frivola (Italian Listed-placed 7.5f 2yo) and Charming Look (Spanish 7.5f-10.5f); dam Italian 1m-1m3f winner (inc 2yo/Listed; RPR 103); likely best watched on debut (yard 0-8 in bumpers last 5 seasons).

runners_data.name: The President
runners_data.spotlight: Walk In The Park filly the first foal out of top class racemare Benie Des Dieux; plenty of appeal on paper and represents a top yard; very interesting debutante; market can guide.

runners_data.name: Vadique
runners_data.spotlight: Vadamos filly; half-sister to 2m3f hurdle winner Mr Finch; dam unraced sister to 2m hurdle/chase winner Stromstad and French 1m4f winner Maelstrom; worth a market check on debut for shrewd yard.

runners_data.name: Velvet Ash
runners_data.spotlight: Sholokhov filly; E8,000 3yo; dam unraced half-sister to winners Fury Road (high-class bumper and 2m4f-3m hurdle/chase) and Monbeg Worldwide (useful bumper/2m4f hurdle); respected source and nicely bred; market can guide on debut.

runners_data.name: Tell The Boys
runners_data.comment: Stayed on into fourth at Wexford on debut (soft); added hood needs to get more from her
runners_data.spotlight: Promise when an 8.5l fourth on debut in Wexford bumper (2m, soft); better again when beaten 2.25l on good ground at Cork (16.5f) in first-time hood (retained) and that form has been well advertised by the third who won next time; leading form claims.

runners_data.name: Born To Caledonie
runners_data.comment: Only 9-1 for Leopardstown debut when beaten 17l on soft-to-heavy; faster ground may help
